description: UK Companies House PSC snapshot, part 1 of 32. PROVENANCE ONLY — the payload is fetched outside the repository, pseudonymized in the reading pass, and deleted. No PSC person name is stored here or anywhere this repository tracks.
licence: Companies House data is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0. The OGL permits reuse; UK data protection law still governs the personal data within it, which is why this project pseudonymizes at ingestion.
